worker_protocol: four concurrent persistent R processes; five-locus chromosome batches; load the official chromosome reference once per batch; checksum every cell input and checkpoint every locus with seven trait-cell hashes

execution_policy.reference_cache_scope: single chromosome batch per persistent R process

numerical_stability_patch.rule: symmetrize only when asymmetry <= 100 * eps * max(1,nrow(M)) * max(1,max(abs(M))); otherwise fail

execution_policy.input_provenance_source: v1 byte-identical materialized locus inputs; bound by exact per-file hashes in v3 receipts

run_policy: Do not create family-level decision or downstream pair results until all 17,465 intended cells are audited and the frozen 5% maximum untested fraction passes.
